The Melbourne installer records frame the work as retrofit onto existing door leaves rather than drop-in fitting: amberpro's Melbourne page scopes the full job as "door prep, drilling, mounting, and app setup", and the smartlocksmelbourne.au review is a "smart deadlock" fitted to an existing hinged door. thesmartlockshop.com.au lists Sunshine inside its "Western Suburbs" service block (Footscray, Sunshine, Braybrook, Altona, Werribee, Hoppers Crossing, Truganina, Tarneit, Point Cook, Melton), which confirms the suburb is serviced as part of that corridor but says nothing about its buildings. No returned record carries any apartment, unit, common-entrance or heritage-timber signal for Sunshine, and none states door material, thickness or build era — treat all of that as unverified and do not assert it.
synthesis.council_notes: None identified — no returned record raises a heritage overlay, owners-corporation rule or rental-provider obligation bearing on changing door hardware in Sunshine or Sunshine West (3020). synthesis.demographic_skew: Insufficient local data — recommend manual research. No returned record carries a tenure, age, household-composition, income or short-stay-turnover signal for Sunshine. The single Sunshine job on record (Airtasker Sunshine West VIC, 30th Jun 2026) is re-keying every external door at once plus adding a security door, which is consistent with either a change of occupancy or an owner security upgrade — the record does not say which, so do not write the page as though renter-versus-owner demand is known.
common_concerns: Whether a smart lock can go on a main entry that already has, or is about to get, a security screen door in front of it — the Airtasker Sunshine West VIC job of 30th Jun 2026 pairs the lock work with "installation of security door for the main entrance".
Getting every external door covered in one visit rather than just the front door — the same Sunshine West job specifies "re-keying on all external doors (4 in total)".

Whether the installer does the physical door work or only the app side — amberpro's Melbourne page sells that distinction explicitly, scoping "the full job: door prep, drilling, mounting, and app setup", which implies customers are having to ask who handles the drilling and mounting.

Whether the installer actually knows the brand the customer bought, and hands it over programmed and working — smartlockinstallation.com.au (Melbourne-confirmed by its own Facebook page, "#1 professional smart lock installer in Melbourne") competes on a ~25-brand list including Samsung, Aqara, Kaadas, Eufy, Klug, Yale, Lockwood and Schlage, and the smartlocksmelbourne.au review singles out that they "helped to program the lock" and "Cleaned up afterwards".
